# Peter Petersen · Portfolio

Static portfolio and résumé site, live at **[ppetersen24.github.io/portfolio](https://ppetersen24.github.io/portfolio/)**.

Vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with no build step. The served site lives in [`site/`](../site); pushes to `main` deploy it through the GitHub Pages workflow in [`.github/workflows/pages.yml`](workflows/pages.yml).
